verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform with documented REST APIs, so offering a downloadable API spec is a fair question. The pack never documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file, MCP server and CLI are adjacent machine-readable surfaces, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
